subject: general
question: What is the primary aim of the Rashtriya Karmayogi Jan Seva Programme launched by the Ministry of Ayush?

options.text: To improve health infrastructure in India
To increase the participation of private sector employees in public service
To build a more accountable, compassionate, and citizen-centric workforce

solution:
The correct answer is __**To build a more accountable, compassionate, and citizen-centric workforce.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Ayush launches the Rashtriya Karmayogi Jan Seva Programme to build a citizen-centric workforce.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Rashtriya Karmayogi Jan Seva Programme aims to build a more accountable, compassionate, and citizen-centric workforce in the Ministry of Ayush.**
 
• The program emphasizes the spirit of “**Seva Bhav**” (service) and encourages public servants to use their roles to bring positive change to people's lives.
 
• It focuses on both service and self-improvement, aiming to upskill employees and broaden their perspectives on their responsibilities.
 
• Training involves hands-on activities like structured discussions, teamwork exercises, and problem-solving to engage employees and foster meaningful public service contributions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Seva Bhav__ **

 __
 
• **“Seva Bhav” translates to the spirit of service and emphasizes the importance of public servants adopting a mindset of service to others.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Capacity Building Commission__ **
 __
 
• **The Capacity Building Commission is responsible for enhancing the skill sets of public servants and transforming the culture of public service in India.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Self-Improvement in Public Service__ **
 
 
• **The program encourages personal growth and self-reflection, motivating employees to improve both in their professional and personal lives to better serve the public.**
 
 ** **
